issues_found.description: Sustained multi-day disk-pressure outage blocking BOTH FUSE<->git sync directions since 2026-08-05: dome-workspace-sync (FUSE->git rescue) has hit 'disk-pressure pre-flight: insufficient free space for a full clone' aborts at least 4 times (2026-08-05, 08-06, 08-07, 08-08T14:53Z - the most recent showing clone_fs_avail_mb=0, sessions_fs_avail_mb=0), and dome-mirror (git->FUSE propagation) has hit the same class of abort at least 5 times over the same window (most recently 2026-08-08T15:00Z). Both agents are behaving correctly per their PROP-051 'degraded-mode prohibitions' - they abort and write a sentinel rather than improvising - but the underlying sandbox disk-pressure condition has now persisted across 4 calendar days without resolving on its own hourly/multi-slot retries. This is the root cause of the workspace-only-file staleness finding below and of the delete_propagation_backlog liveness gap.
issues_found.suggested_fix: Operator should inspect the scheduled-task sandbox disk state directly (each of these agents runs in its own isolated session/sandbox, so this is not the same /tmp as this integrity run's clone). If it's accumulated stale clones or other cruft rather than genuine resource exhaustion, a manual cleanup of the workspace-sync/dome-mirror task sandboxes is likely needed since the automated per-run cleanup isn't recovering the space. Escalate to tinker for pipeline-health investigation if it doesn't self-resolve within another day.

summary: Site structural health is good: node test.js passed 3838/3838, all 10 PROP-111 mechanical precompute checks passed cleanly (internal anchors, relative hrefs, data-prose consistency, WIN detail/TLDR structure, hardcoded colors, discoverability infra, expansion tracker, ISS collisions, broken review files), tab structure is intact (12 tabs, correct nav chain, 'overview' active on load), build reproducibility is clean (published HTML matches source data - only the auto date-stamp differs), and the live Pages site is byte-signature FRESH against git HEAD. WIN-dome alignment (5b) confirms all 69 dome WIN numbers are covered with 0 drift; the known WIN-062 dup-id monitoring condition is unchanged (hash match). External-link checks were skipped per weekly cadence (today is Saturday); last Monday's run (07-27) was clean. The one real story this run surfaces is operational, not structural: dome-workspace-sync and dome-mirror have both been hitting 'insufficient free space for a full clone' pre-flight aborts repeatedly since 2026-08-05 (4 and 5 abort sentinels respectively, most recent today), which has stalled FUSE<->git sync in both directions for 3-4 days. This is the direct cause of a stranded curmudgeon review file (WIN-021.c6.json, 83h old, never committed) and of a delete-propagation-backlog liveness gap (dome-mirror's last successful sentinel is 102h old). The safety gates themselves are working exactly as designed (fail-closed, no improvisation), but the underlying disk-pressure condition is untracked and has now persisted across 4 calendar days - worth an operator look. No critical findings; nothing indicates the published site itself is broken or drifted for end users.
